Tom — quick answers inline below. Forwarding to Marcus for the deep technical sync.

> 1) Can you confirm whether Private (VPC) supports regional-only storage (no cross-region backups)?
Yes — our Private deployment can be configured to keep storage and snapshots in a single region. We also offer an opt-in backup replication for DR (which we would not enable by default).

> 2) Do you have a standard approach for integrating with our Okta SSO and our HSM-backed KMS?
We support SAML-based SSO with Okta for the control plane and application-level SSO for operator access. For KMS, we integrate with customer-managed cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and HSMs via KMIP — Marcus can walk through the exact network and key lifecycle requirements on the call.

> 3) Can you give a ballpark cost per month for the scale we discussed (40 steady / spikes to 150)?
Ballpark (very high level):
- Private VPC (dedicated pool): $18k–$30k / month depending on instance shape, retention & HA configuration.
- On-prem: one-time onboarding + hardware + annual maintenance; typically >$200k first-year total with longer procurement lead times.
